newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen October same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen October same-store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Monday its October same-store sales rose 9.8 percent. Total sales advanced 15.4 percent to $1.04 billion from $902.2 million in the same year-ago period.
The drugstore company said it anticipates an strong Christmas season will continue its strong sales trend.
Calendar year to date, Walgreens said sales were $9.82 billion, up 14.1 percent from $8.61 billion in 1995.
Fiscal year to date sales for the two months were $1,995,380,000, up 14.2 percent from $1.747,834,000.
Pharmacy sales, which account for 45 percent of overall sales, increased 18.0 percent in October while comparable pharmacy sales rose 12.8 percent.
At October 31, Walgreens operated 2,204 drugstores versus 2,099 a year ago.
